name: The Business Platinum Card from American Express

loungeAccess.network: Amex Global Lounge Collection (1,550+ lounges in 140 countries)
otherLounges: American Express Centurion Lounges (15 US locations)
Delta Sky Club (limited when flying Delta)
loungeAccess.notes: Same lounge access as personal Amex Platinum. Centurion Lounges: up to 2 guests at $50/guest. Priority Pass: enrollment required. Delta Sky Club: must be flying Delta; limited visits per year.

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $20,000 every 12 months across all claims.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, electronics) capped at $1,000 per person per trip. Delayed baggage is NOT covered — only lost/stolen/damaged.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a standard benefit on the Business Platinum.

emergencyMedical.notes: Premium Global Assist: 24/7 hotline for emergency medical evacuation at no cost to cardholder for transport. Does NOT cover medical treatment costs.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: The Business Platinum offers PRIMARY rental car insurance (vs. secondary on personal Platinum). Up to $75,000, up to 30 days.

airlineCredit.notes: $200 annual airline fee credit for one selected qualifying airline for incidental fees (baggage, upgrades, etc.) — NOT airfare.

hotelCredit.notes: $200 annual hotel credit for prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection bookings through Amex Travel.

otherCredits.name: Dell Technologies Credit
otherCredits.notes: $200 Jan-Jun + $200 Jul-Dec for U.S. purchases at Dell Technologies. For computers, monitors, and accessories.

otherCredits.name: Indeed Credit
otherCredits.notes: $90 per quarter ($360/year) for Indeed.com hiring credits.

otherCredits.name: Adobe Credit
otherCredits.notes: $150 annually on eligible Adobe purchases (Creative Cloud, Acrobat DC).

otherCredits.name: Wireless Telephone Services Credit
otherCredits.notes: $10/month ($120/year) statement credit on U.S. wireless telephone services charged directly from a wireless provider.

otherCredits.name: 35% Pay with Points Rebate
otherCredits.notes: Get 35% of your points back when you use Pay with Points for first or business class flights on your selected airline, or any seat on any airline booked through Amex Travel. Up to 1,000,000 bonus points back per calendar year.

rewards.travelRate: 5x on flights and prepaid hotels booked through Amex Travel; 5x on flights booked directly with airlines (up to $500,000/year at 5x, then 1x)
otherBonusCategories: 1.5x on eligible purchases of $5,000 or more (up to 1,000,000 bonus points per year)
1.5x on US construction material and hardware stores, electronic goods retailers, software companies, shipping providers, and advertising purchases made with select media

pointValue.transferPartners: 1:1 transfer to 20+ airline and hotel partners. 35% points rebate on first/business class redemptions.

travelPerks: Amex Centurion Lounge access with guest privileges
Delta Sky Club access when flying Delta
$200 annual hotel credit (Fine Hotels + Resorts / The Hotel Collection)
Primary rental car insurance up to $75,000
Premium Global Assist — emergency evacuation coordination
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
35% points rebate on first/business class Pay with Points
1:1 transfer to 20+ airline and hotel partners
bestFor: Business travelers who fly frequently and can maximize the travel credits, lounge access, and business-specific credits (Dell, Indeed, Adobe)
